entities.name: Battle at the Ozolith
entities.description: Battle in 4561 AR that broke Lukka's alliance with the bonders and Vivien.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: Crystalline structure with corruptive psychic power over nightmares.

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: Bonder who touches the Ozolith and becomes commander of nightmares.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker who attacks Lukka with her Arkbow.

entities.name: Abda
entities.description: Bonder partnered with Rigi, killed by a ballista shot.

entities.name: Rigi
entities.description: Spiked badger bonded to Abda, reanimated by the Ozolith.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: Commander seeking to retrieve Lukka alive.

entities.name: Falk
entities.description: Captain of the airship Vermilion, killed in the crash.

entities.name: Vermilion
entities.description: Falk's airship, crushed by a nightmare snake.

entities.name: Mzed
entities.description: Leader of elite monster hunters, last of them to fall.

entities.name: Johannes
entities.description: Gunner who shot Abda, killed in the crash.

entities.name: Nightmares
entities.description: Corrupted monsters controlled via the Ozolith.

events.summary: The bonders and Vivien arrive at the Ozolith and plan for Lukka to reach the central crystal while the others hold off the nightmares.
events.quote: Vivien proposed a plan for him to reach the central crystal while the others held off the defenders

events.summary: Lukka and his winged cat break through and Lukka touches the central Ozolith, pulled into a vision; the Vermilion arrives to retrieve him.
Johannes shoots Abda dead with the Vermilion's ballistae while Jirina observes.
events.quote: managed to land a fatal shot on Abda

events.summary: The Ozolith pulses, reanimates Rigi and sends the nightmares into a frenzy that kills the hunters and Mzed.
events.quote: Mzed was the last to fall

events.summary: A nightmare snake brings down the Vermilion, killing Rigi, Falk and Johannes; Jirina sees Lukka in the Ozolith and Leori carries her away.
events.quote: while the Vermillion crashed to the ground, killing Rigi, Falk, and Johannes

events.summary: Lukka tries to seize Zeph and Rol; Vivien hurls him away with her Arkbow and the bonders flee.
Lukka assembles an army of nightmares and sets his sights on Drannith.
events.quote: fully embracing his new role as their commander, and setting his sights on Drannith

relations.note: Falk is her commander aboard Vermilion; Falk also named her commander
relations.quote: Jirina Kudro and her commander, Falk
the bonded pair Abda and Rigi
managed to land a fatal shot on Abda
Lukka assembled a growing army of nightmares
